Kingmakers - 12 Minute Gameplay Overview Deep Dive
Get a closer look at Kingmakers, the upcoming medieval action-strategy sandbox. In this Gameplay Deep Dive, the developers provide brand-new details on the game's story and key gameplay systems such as combat, settlement management, and RTS mechanics. 

Go back in time to a war-torn medieval era with a vast arsenal of modern weapons, change the course of history, and save the future in Kingmakers. Build your kingdom, grab a gun, and lead an army of thousands into massive, real-time simulated battles — solo or in co-op.
